article.headline: Kuhl's 14 help Stetson down Howard 64-60
article.description: — Collin Kuhl scored 14 points as Stetson beat Howard 64-60 on Wednesday.
article.story: DELAND, Fla. -- — Collin Kuhl scored 14 points as Stetson beat Howard 64-60 on Wednesday. Kuhl added six rebounds for the Hatters (2-3). Jamie Phillips Jr. added 13 points while going 4 of 12 from the floor and 3 for 5 from the line while he also had eight rebounds. Jake Johnson had 11 points and finished 2 of 4 from 3-point range and 5 for 5 from the line. The Bison (2-3) were led by Bryce Harris, who recorded 26 points and 12 rebounds. Alex Cotton added 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
